description: Change a giveaway that has not started: prize, sponsor, winners, rules, posts, end time, the rules text or whether its proof page is public. Once it runs the rules are frozen (cancel and start a new one). Changing the prize, sponsor, winners, rules, posts or end time re-drafts the rules text unless the person edited it.

alternates_count.description: How many backup winners to draw, e.g. 2

claim_ask.description: What a winner is asked for when claiming, e.g. {"address": true}

claim_hours.description: Hours a winner has to answer, e.g. 48

commitment_scope.description: Where the rules comment goes: on every post (all) or on the first post only, with the links of the rest (first). Default: all up to 5 posts, first above

ends_local.description: When entries close, local time without offset, e.g. 2026-10-17T18:00

giveaway_id.description: ID of the giveaway (a UUID): from giveaway_list

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

media_ids.description: The giveaway's posts in full as Instagram media ids of its account, the first one first; instead of post_ids

post_ids.description: The giveaway's posts in full, the first one first; all published posts of its account

prize_text.description: What the winner gets, in a sentence; a list of prizes goes in rules.prizes, one line each

prize_value_text.description: The prize's value in words, like "$120"; optional

proof_public.description: true shows the draw proof on the public page; default false

rules.description: Rules object; its fields are in the tool's schema (tool_search with name)

rules_text.description: The official rules in full; replaces the drafted text

sponsor_name.description: Who runs the giveaway; defaults to the account's name

timezone.description: IANA time zone for ends_local, e.g. America/New_York

winners_count.description: How many winners to draw, e.g. 1

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: giveaway_update
title: Change a draft giveaway
